title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the electric field must be correctly stated as E >= 2 x 10^9 Z^3 V/cm.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the ionization energy as 13.6 Z^2 eV must be correctly applied.

title: Distance from Nucleus
description: Important Criteria: The average distance a = a_0/Z must be correctly identified and used in the calculations.

title: Energy from Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The relationship eEa must be correctly established to relate the electric field to the energy needed to eject the electron.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for energy and electric field.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in energy calculations or misinterpretation of inequalities.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to include the factor of e in the energy from the electric field can lead to incorrect results.
